timestamp_policy: Preserve TimeSpec sec/nanosec exactly; drop identical duplicate stamps; stop on backward clock or changed data at the same stamp.

authorization: User authorized continuing offline diagnosis and fixes until heading issue is resolved.
limitations: Fixed bias plus measured body gyro Z gain; no full three-axis scale or misalignment calibration.
